 Emkay Global Financial' research report on Vedanta 
 HZL (~90% of VEDL’s EBITDA) beat our/consensus’ 2Q estimates, with reported EBITDA at Rs92.9bn (+14.2% qoq) as zinc CoP fell to $703/t from $851/t. Net cash stood at Rs112.7bn after a record FCF of Rs62.0bn. Management cut its FY27 guidance for CoP to $825-850/t, kept its 680t silver production target, while remaining constructive on Zn and Ag given supply deficits.
 Outlook 
 We believe the recent Ag price correction is a near-term risk, which should though be offset by higher volumes; also, spot prices point to further upside. We maintain BUY and TP of Rs350.
